card.text: Explore Kerberos through a clearly labeled approximate shape fit.

introduction.text: Kerberos is a tiny, elongated moon in the Pluto–Charon system. New Horizons glimpsed it in 2015, but its possible double-lobed shape and spin orientation remain uncertain.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: New Horizons shape estimate. A two-lobed form remains possible; the pole is uncertain. No imagery is mapped.
